about_the_game:
Embark on an enchanting journey through the vibrant, mystical world of Zulu legend in Tower of Wishes: Shaka, a captivating match-3 adventure that blends rich storytelling with engaging puzzle gameplay.

The kingdom of Ilanga faces its darkest hour. Invaders with fire-breathing weapons threaten your borders, an unnatural drought withers your crops, and the amadlozi keep demanding ever increasing sacrifices.

The situation is grim and there is but one hope: The Tower of Wishes, an ancient monument that appears only when the moon swallows the sun.

As the noble king Vusumuzi, ascend the tower, solving puzzles, matching beads and overcoming challenges to save your people from famine, invaders, and the wrath of the ancestral spirits.

Game Features

  • Fun match-3 puzzles that test your wit.

  • Mini-Games Galore: Play mini-games that offer different challenges, from hidden objects to jigsaw puzzles.

  • Uncover the mysteries of the Tower as you progress.

  • African themed art that brings the Tower of Wishes to life.

  • Make a wish that will shape the future of your kingdom and its people.
